content: Kodi 20 Nexus added typed InfoTag setters. xbmcgui.ListItem.getVideoInfoTag() returns InfoTagVideo whose v20 setters include setDuration(int seconds), setPlot, setTitle, setMediaType, setGenres(list), setCast, setResumePoint(float time,[float totaltime]), setUniqueIDs, setDbId, setYear, setSeason, setEpisode, setPremiered, setDateAdded, setPath, setFilenameAndPath. setDuration explicitly takes 'integer - Duration in seconds' (floats are wrong). v21 added setVideoAssetTitle; v22 added setOriginalLanguage and setAvailableFanart. ListItem.setInfo() is deprecated for most video properties in v20 and logs a deprecation warning; Kodi policy is deprecate in v20 then remove in a later major. Parallel classes: InfoTagMusic (getMusicInfoTag), InfoTagPicture (getPictureInfoTag), InfoTagGame.
